name: Bing: Images Download
summary: Collect up to N (default 100) full-size original Bing Images URLs, Extra-large by default; with --download-dir the CLI saves the originals.
description: Run a Bing Images search in a fresh tab, scroll the grid until `count` results are loaded (default 100, max 500), and return the original full-size URLs (Bing's `m.murl`) as `image_urls` plus per-item metadata. Run with `--download-dir <dir>` and the CLI downloads every original into `<dir>/images/`. Use when you want the actual image files. Do not use when you only need metadata for a handful of results (`bing_images_search`).

count.description: How many images to collect. Defaults to 100. Capped by how far the grid loads in ~24s of scrolling.

size.description: Bing size filter: `wallpaper` (Bing's Extra large, the default), `large`, or `any` (no filter).

min_width.description: Skip images narrower than this many pixels (0 = no minimum).

min_height.description: Skip images shorter than this many pixels (0 = no minimum).

steps.name: Wait for the Bing Images search box
Allow the image grid to hydrate
Apply Bing's image-size filter (same as picking it in the Filter menu)
Allow the filtered grid to load
Wait for the filtered image grid
Scroll the grid and collect original image URLs

help.summary: Collect up to N (default 100) full-size original Bing Images URLs, Extra-large by default; with --download-dir the CLI saves the originals.

parameters.count: How many images to collect (default 100, max 500).
parameters.size: Bing size filter: `wallpaper` (Bing's Extra large, the default), `large`, or `any` (no filter).
parameters.min_width: Skip images narrower than this many pixels (0 = no minimum).
parameters.min_height: Skip images shorter than this many pixels (0 = no minimum).

examples.command: rzn-browser run bing images-download --param search_query="red pandas" --download-dir ~/Pictures/red-pandas
examples.description: Saves up to 100 full-size red panda images to ~/Pictures/red-pandas/images/.

examples.command: rzn-browser run bing images-download --param search_query="red pandas" --param count=30 --download-dir ~/Pictures/red-pandas
rzn-browser run bing images-download --param search_query="red pandas" --param min_width=3840 --download-dir ~/Pictures/red-pandas
examples.description: Only originals at least 3840 px wide (4K).

returns: { requested, items_count, image_urls[] (original full-size URLs), items[] { title, width, height, high_res_url, thumbnail_url, source_page } }. With --download-dir, files land in <dir>/images/NNN_<host>_<name> and a manifest is written alongside.
notes: Drives the Images landing's real search input rather than hitting `?q=...` directly.

`size` re-runs the search with Bing's own size filter (`qft=+filterui:imagesize-*`), the same URL the Filter menu produces. `min_width`/`min_height` filter on the original dimensions Bing reports for each result.

Originals are fetched from their host sites by the CLI (no browser cookies). Some hosts block hotlinking or have dead links; those are logged as [WARN] and skipped, so expect slightly fewer files than `count`.
Re-running into the same directory skips files that already exist.
